Outcome_variable.evidence_source: [023_33_the_structural_model] The structural model included paths from baseline (Time 1) life satisfaction to Time 2 and Time 3 life satisfaction, and from Time 2 life satisfaction to Time 3 life satisfaction. Additionally, paths were included from baseline (Time 1) life satisfaction to Time 2 and Time 3 positive affect and negative affect, and from Time 2 life satisfaction to Time 3 positive affect and negative affect. Similarly, paths were included from baseline (Time 1) positive affect to Time 2 and Time 3 positive affect and negative affect, and from Time 2 positive affect to Time 3 positive affect and negative affect. Finally, paths were included from baseline (Time 1) negative affect to Time 2 and Time 3 negative affect and positive affect, and from Time 2 negative affect to Time 3 negative affect and positive affect.
